messages:
samantha: :rotating_light: Seeing a 6x spike in 502/504s for hosted inference in us-west-3 from ~16:05-16:12. Multiple customer escalations, some timeouts turned into auth failures. Anyone seeing network noise?
lee: on it, pulling BGP/peering graphs now. any customer IDs or sample request ids?
maya: Customer A reported timeouts and repeated charge attempts, billing page showed retries. I have a sample request-id: req_0a1b2c3d. They sent curl repro.
maya: curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate" -d '{"model":"redwood-2","input":"hello"}'
ajay: telemetry-bot shows increased gateway latency + retried upstream connections for us-west-3 edge cluster between 16:03 and 16:13. Prefix-loss spike on provider X links.
telemetry-bot: summary: us-west-3 edge: packet-drop-rate from 0.02% -> 1.9% at 16:04, BGP flaps observed on transit-asn 64501.
lee: net-bot confirms multiple BGP withdraws for our egress prefixes via peer-asn 64501 at 16:04:12 and 16:06:02. Possible partial blackhole causing TCP stalls -> timeouts then gateway 502s.
oncall-network: I picked up the PagerDuty for this. Repro steps: repro with repeated small payloads caused ~30% timeout on first try, subsequent tries succeeded when routed differently.
maya: Customer impact: 3 midsize customers reported partial failures, 2 had billing retries flagged. Opened support tickets and escalated to enterprise team.
samantha: Any mitigation? Can we force fallback routing to alt-transit for affected AZ?
lee: I've pushed a temporary routing preference to favor peer-asn 65022 for us-west-3 egress. BGP convergence in progress, will announce when stable.
devops-bot: Routing change applied to edge-router group us-west-3-edge-01..04. Propagation ~45s.
ajay: Observability: request traces show KV-cache hits unaffected, errors are at gateway handshake/timeout stage. N+1 fallback to smaller instance pools triggered for some customers.
maya: Notifying customers: sending status update that we're investigating network provider disruption and applying routing fallback.
samantha: Good. After we stabilize, let's capture pcap + flow logs for 16:00-16:15 window and correlate with provider BGP logs. Also add mitigation postmortem checklist.
lee: Saved pcap slice, grabbing ifindex and timestamps. Will post artifacts to incident channel when ready.
oncall-network: marking incident as HANDLED -> monitoring. If no new flaps in 15m, we'll close and draft postmortem. :eyes:
